content: Man'be anà ndwääl a nkul
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: « Yà ndandaa naa taaŋ lanswà baar ban'kwo bàbü u man'be, wɛɛ ngyɛb akà mbuur awà mbwo ntɔn mbweel a un'tɔŋ ande.
Yubwaŋ akà nde naa bun'bäm nkɔŋ a kölàköl u bway anà bun'tɔɔm u ngyäl, akwà naa nde mubwiy umwɛy uboo a baan ambɛy bà.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo! Isàkal naa un'tɔŋ angye kan'kyer man'be, un'pɛ an'lwɛŋ. Nde usàsɔɔmà, un'dwääl nkul.
Itàkal naa nde kàmakyer ube mbalà nsambwaar kà ilä mwɛy wɛɛ nde akayaa akà ngye taaŋ lanswà naa nde akyer asɔɔmà, un'dwääl nkul. »
Làkwikilà
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy antööm bàtɛn a Mwol naa: « Kwɛy làkwikilà abi. »

Mwol waa kàfuur naa: « Isàkal naa ndandaa bɛ làbye anà làkwikilà làtàkal ikikye asànaa imbɛŋ a làpɔ̈ɔ̈là, bɛ lan'kwo muswaŋ un'te a kölàköl naa: "Tsumà pà, kyen kambär uboo a ngyäl!" Wa akyer alàwem. »
Buur a un'syääl

Yɛsu kàkwɛy naa: « Bi itàwal naa umwɛy uboo abɛ ukäl anà un'tsüüŋ ande isal ande mulem, taaŋ lumwɛy mudii ntsür. Uman nde kan'fà an'ywaŋ kan'yàfurà, nkye nde ayàtɛn a nde naa: "Yà agyägyä, bwaay u mɛsà"?
Aay, nde ayàtɛn a nde naa: "Ndääm isaa, bwaar ubwaŋ, yà yan'pɛ udyà, manà mɛ an'may mudyà anà munwà, ungö ngye sye waa ayàdyà anà ayànwà."
Nkye nkum kan'kwo mupà ndä akà un'tsüüŋ ande ntɔn nde kan'kyer isal kyanswà kun'swɛŋ nde?
Ya sye ye abwɛy ntɔn bɛ. Isàkal naa bɛ lan'kyer isal kyanswà bàlaswɛŋ, làtɛn naa: "Bi ibà atsüüŋ ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ: bi kan'kyer isal kan'kwo bi mukyer." »
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr aŋakyal a bay kwem
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàkäl mukyà Yɛlusàlɛm, nde kàsoonà ndel a Samalya anà Ngalilɛ.
Mpal kàkäl nde tsütsü mubilà u bul mwɛy, aŋakyal a bay kwem bàyi akà nde, ba bàmbär u kwɛl
waa bàsɛn ndaa: « Yɛsu, Un'lɔɔŋ, iwem ngyɛb! »
Mpal kamɛn Yɛsu, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làkyen kàlamɛnà akà angaŋ. » Mpal bàkäl ba u mbwo, laa bàkɔɔrà ba.
Umwɛy uboo aba kàmɛn nde naa nde kan'kɔɔrà, waa kàyàfurà, wàmuyisyäŋà Nzam u ndaa a dudu.
Apan, waa kàbü, ntabwey u mɛɛn, kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kun'kömà. Mbuur awà kàkäl un'nsi Samalya.
Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Ba bàkwem bàkyer akɔɔrà, wɛɛ bàken baar wà bumwɛy?
Akà mbuur mwɛy ukäl anki anà an'kyän muyàfurà ntɔn mukömà Nzam, ilàkɔɔn akal ungyey abarankye wà? »
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mbarà, kyen, làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Ngyeel a Imwol
Ilä mwɛy Amfarisi bàfuul Yɛsu naa imwol a Nzam isàyà mpal yɛn. Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Imwol a Nzam iyà anki asànaa undiir a ubem.
Bàsàtɛn anki naa: "Làler, kya aki kà." Taaŋ lumwɛy naa: "Kya kyà kunà." Ntɔn, làyöb naa Imwol a Nzam kyà uboo a bɛ. »
Apan nde waa kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: « Taaŋ là paa làsàkwen bɛ muman Mwan a mbuur itàkal ilä mwɛy mpɛl, wɛɛ bɛ làsun'man anki.
Ba bàsàlakyäänà naa: "Làler kunà!", taaŋ lumwɛy naa: "Làler kà!" Wɛɛ twon lan'kyà, twon lan'kaamà ntiin.
Ilä a Mwan a mbuur isàkal asànaa muŋyä ufàparà wa udu, anà ufàpà wa kyɛɛy awa ntsü anà ntsü.
Wɛɛ kusà nde akyer atàman mpay mbɔɔn anà baar a mpalàbà bàkyer un'tɔn.
Lalan ndaa yàlyaaŋ utaaŋ a Nɔwa, isàkal sye kà ilä a Mwan a mbuur.
Baar bàkyer afadyaa, bàkyer afanwaa, bàkyer afataa an'bɔr, bàkyer afapaa baan aba an'bɔr, tii ilä kàbilà Nɔwà kà an'swà. An'dà màyööl ma mɛɛn, laa bàkü ba banswà.
Isàkal sye asànaa utaaŋ a Lɔti: baar bàkyer afadyaa, bàkyer afanwaa, bàkyer afasoomà, bàkyer afayälà, bàkyer afakɔnà, bàkyer afatɔŋà.
Wɛɛ ilä kàtoo Lɔti u Sɔdɔm, mbul a in'kul a mbaa laa kàfü wa du, kàdwä wa ba banswà.
Ya isàkal abà sye kà ilä a Mwan a mbuur usàmɛnà nde.
Ilä akin, mbuur asàkal udu a nsyä a ndwà ande, ufàsàbilà anki u ndwà ntɔn mukàwal indiir ande, ifà imwɛy sye akà mbuur asàkal kan'ywaŋ usàkwo anki mufurà ndwà ande.
Làyɔbà un'kyay a Lɔti!
Mbuur asàkwen muyee mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande, wa asàkyà bwà, wɛɛ mbuur asàkɔɔb mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande, akyer asàwal wa.
Mɛ alàkyään naa: u mpib ayin, baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal ibɔ̈ɔ̈n imwɛy: umwɛy bàkyer asun'syen, umwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy.
Akaar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal mutswà ikal imwɛy: un'mwɛy bàkyer asun'syen, un'mwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy.
Abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal kà ibɔr: umwɛy bàkyer asun'syen, un'mwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy. »
Alɔŋki ande bun'fuul naa: « Mwol, ndaa ayi isàkal ken? » Waa nde kafuur naa: « Ntsü isàkal ndom, akun sye inkaak isàköŋ bya. »
